+name: Repository build
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    outputs:
+      lean: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.lean }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.11'
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
+        with:
+          node-version: '24'
+      - name: Identify shared Lean changes
+        id: scope
+        env:
+          BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+        run: |
+          if git diff --name-only "$BASE" HEAD | grep '^formal/lean/' > /dev/null; then
+            echo 'lean=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          fi
+      - name: Build the public release
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python3 -m pip install -r scripts/requirements-content.txt
+          python3 scripts/build-content.py
+          python3 scripts/validate-records.py
+          python3 scripts/check-content.py
+          python3 infra/aws/package.py --site . --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/release" --static-only
+  lean:
+    needs: build
+    if: needs.build.outputs.lean == 'true'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          fetch-depth: 0
+      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.11'
+      - name: Prepare pinned Lean
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python3 -m pip install -r scripts/requirements-content.txt
+          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/v4.2.0/elan-init.sh -o /tmp/elan-init.sh
+          sh /tmp/elan-init.sh -y --default-toolchain none
+          echo "$HOME/.elan/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+      - name: Prepare shared Lean dependencies
+        working-directory: formal/lean
+        run: |
+          lake exe cache get
+          lake build HodgeComputer.Verify
+      - name: Shared modules and protected applications
+        env:
+          BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+        run: python3 scripts/check-library.py --base "$BASE"

-

-`assets/surface.js` provides the page-side `HodgeRenderer` controller. `assets/surface-worker.js` runs `assets/renderer.js` in an OffscreenCanvas worker.
